items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being increasingly targeted by AI-generated scams that are more convincing and personalised than ever before. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has flagged that TeamCity servers — software used by development and IT teams — are actively being exploited in Australia right now, meaning any organisation running this software should treat patching as urgent.

If your business uses TeamCity, contact your IT team or provider today to confirm it has been updated. More broadly, be cautious of unexpected emails or messages that seem unusually tailored to your business — AI is making scam attempts harder to spot.

**Tip:** If an email feels oddly specific about your business, verify the sender by phone before clicking anything.

featured.title: AI fuels targeted scams against Australian small firms
featured.summary: Targeted fraud is inflicting bigger losses on small firms as AI helps criminals forge convincing invoices and impersonations in Australia.
